Name: Buckeye Horse Retexture
Author: SihaRakhet
Description:
A new texture for the horse modeled after an American Paint horse my granmother owned when I was little. 

I used Redesigned Horse Running Animation by avalitor because the vanilla horse is too stumpy for me! XD

Here is a link to their mod: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/261/?

I've spent too much time making skins to actually get the the point where I own a horse so let me know if there are any issues and I'll see what I can do.

Installation: Just drop the Content file into the main Stardew Valley folder and overwrite when asked.
